subject: Calendar/share request: free Bachata for medical students — Sept 24
body:
Hi team,

I'm a Stanford doctoral student helping organize Stanford Bachata Sensual & Brazilian Zouk. I saw that you accept event-calendar submissions, and we'd love to welcome medical and physician assistant students to our first Bachata class of the quarter tonight :)

Could you add the details below to the calendar and share through an appropriate student announcement channel if it fits? I know this is short notice; if tonight is too late, I'd appreciate knowing the preferred process and lead time for future classes.

Dance with us this Autumn Quarter!

Bachata Sensual — Thursday, September 24, 2026
Escondido Village Graduate Residences (EVGR) C Dance Studio
7–8 PM beginner | 8–9 PM intermediate | 9–10 PM social/practice
Instructor: Dvij Patel

Free for Stanford students and affiliates. Beginners welcome—no partner or experience needed!

Community links and future class updates: https://linktr.ee/stanfordbachatazouk
Contact: Brando Miranda, brando9@stanford.edu

Thanks!
Brando

-----
Brando Miranda
Ph.D. Student
Computer Science, Stanford University
EDGE Scholar, Stanford University
brando9@stanford.edu
website: https://brando90.github.io/brandomiranda/
